meta.title: OlhoVivo — property evaluation and investment scenarios
meta.description: See what a property is worth, how much it can earn and which strategy makes sense: resale, long-term rental, short-term rental or contract assignment.

home.title: Know whether a property is worth it before you commit
home.subtitle: Paste a listing link or enter the property details. OlhoVivo works out taxes, costs and financing and compares four investment strategies.
home.step1Text: Paste the listing link or fill in location, typology, area and price.
home.step2Text: See INE's median sale price and rent for the parish and municipality.
home.step3Text: Market value, rent, nightly rate and occupancy: the values you expect to achieve.
home.step4Text: IMT, stamp duty, income tax and financing worked out automatically for each scenario.
home.pricesText: Median sale price and rent per m² in every district, municipality and parish.

scenarios.flipText: Buy, renovate and sell: net profit after costs, taxes and capital gains.
scenarios.longTermRentalText: Monthly rent, gross and net yield, cash flow and payback.
scenarios.shortTermRentalText: Nightly rate and occupancy by season, platform fees, cleaning and taxes.
scenarios.contractAssignmentText: Sell your position in the promissory contract (CPCV) before the deed: profit and return on the deposit.

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity analysis
sensitivity.intro: See how results change if the price, rent, occupancy or interest rate turn out different from what you expect. Every scenario is recalculated.

variableLong.rent: Change in rent and nightly rate

sensitivity.tableCaption: Chosen metric for each scenario, current and with the change
sensitivity.chartTitle: Chosen metric across the whole range
sensitivity.noResults: Enter the market values to see the sensitivity analysis.
sensitivity.premium: Sensitivity analysis is included in the Premium plan.

metrics.totalInvestmentHelp: Purchase price plus acquisition costs, renovation, furnishing and licences.
metrics.ownCapitalHelp: The money you put in yourself: total investment minus the loan.
metrics.peakCapitalHelp: The most you have invested at any point, including costs while the property earns nothing.
metrics.netProfitHelp: Everything you receive minus everything you pay, including the final sale, after taxes and the loan.
metrics.roiHelp: Return on own capital: net profit divided by the own capital invested.
metrics.irrHelp: Internal rate of return: the equivalent annual return, taking into account when each euro goes in and out.
metrics.grossYieldHelp: Annual rent divided by the purchase price plus acquisition costs.
metrics.netYieldHelp: Annual rent minus operating costs and taxes, divided by the total investment. Excludes the loan.
metrics.monthlyCashFlowHelp: What is left (or missing) each month in the first full year, after costs, taxes and loan payments.
metrics.paybackYearsHelp: Years until cash flow pays back your own capital, not counting the sale.
metrics.returnOnDepositHelp: Net profit of the assignment divided by the deposit paid on the CPCV.
metrics.acquisitionCostsHelp: IMT, stamp duty, deed and registry, and bank fees if there is a loan.

warnings.vpt_estimated: Tax value (VPT) unknown: IMI was calculated on the purchase price, which may overstate it.
warnings.ltv_above_limit: The loan exceeds Banco de Portugal's recommended limit (80% for investment, 90% for your own home).
warnings.holding_shorter_than_renovation: The holding period is shorter than the renovation.
warnings.negative_cash_flow: Monthly cash flow is negative: you will need to cover the difference every month.
warnings.al_containment_zone: Short-term rental containment zone: new registrations may be restricted.
warnings.al_registrations_suspended: New short-term rental registrations are suspended in this area.
warnings.al_status_unknown: We could not confirm whether new short-term rental registrations are allowed.
warnings.al_vat_threshold_exceeded: Annual turnover is above the VAT exemption threshold (15 000 €). Consider charging VAT.
warnings.assignment_above_market: The buyer of the position would pay more than the market value you entered.
warnings.assignment_upfront_imt: With an assignment clause in the CPCV, IMT and stamp duty may be due when it is signed.
warnings.imt_non_resident: Non-resident buyer: flat 7.5% IMT (since 20/05/2026). The difference is refunded if you become resident in Portugal within 2 years, or let at a capped rent within 6 months for at least 36 of the first 60 months.

evaluate.intro: Enter the property, compare it with local prices, add the values you expect and see which strategy makes the most sense.

evaluate.marketValueHelp: What the property is worth today, as it is.
evaluate.resaleValueHelp: What you expect to sell for after renovating (resale scenario).
evaluate.nightlyRatesHelp: Average price charged per night in each season, VAT included where applicable.
evaluate.occupancyRatesHelp: Share of nights booked in each season.
evaluate.cpcvPriceHelp: Price agreed in the promissory purchase contract (CPCV).
evaluate.depositHelp: Amount paid when the CPCV was signed (sinal).
evaluate.assignmentPriceHelp: Total the new buyer pays you for the position, including the deposit reimbursement.
evaluate.upfrontTransferTaxes: CPCV allows assignment to a third party

evaluate.loanAmountHelp: Banks usually lend up to 80% of the value for investment properties.

evaluate.marginalTaxRateHelp: Your IRS bracket. Applies to capital gains and short-term rental income.
evaluate.contractYearsHelp: Leases of 5, 10 or 20 years have reduced rates.
evaluate.assumptionsHelp: Reasonable defaults. Adjust them to your case.
evaluate.vptHelp: Shown on the caderneta predial. Leave blank if unknown.
evaluate.appreciationHelp: Used to estimate the sale price at the end of the rental period.
evaluate.vacancyHelp: Share of the year without a tenant.

legal.draft: Draft. This text will be reviewed before launch.
legal.aboutText: OlhoVivo helps investors evaluate property in Portugal: it compares the price with the market and works out taxes, costs and financing for four investment strategies.
legal.contactsText: For questions about OlhoVivo, contact us by email. The address will be published before launch.
legal.privacyText: We only process the data needed to provide the service, under the GDPR. Contact requests are used only to answer them. You can ask to access, correct or delete your data at any time.
legal.termsText: OlhoVivo's calculations are estimates based on the values entered by the user and on public tax parameters. They are not financial, tax or legal advice.
legal.cookiesText: OlhoVivo only uses essential cookies (language and theme). We do not use analytics or advertising cookies.
